profile.title: Settings
profile.headerHint: This text will appear as the heading on stock cards. Use line breaks (Enter) to create multiple lines.
profile.businessSettingsDesc: These settings will be used on stock cards and documents.
profile.personalInfoDesc: Manage your personal information and profile settings
profile.identityDesc: This name and logo will serve as the official branding for all generated stock cards, receipts, and system-wide reports.
profile.dataMgmtDesc: Manage your data backups, restore from backups, delete your account, or reset all data.
profile.backupDesc: Create a backup of all your data including the database, signatures, photos, and logos. You can use this backup to restore your data later.
profile.restoreDesc: Restore your data from a previously created backup file. This will replace your current data with the backup data.
profile.restoreWarning:
⚠️ WARNING: Restoring a backup will:
- Replace your current database with the backup
- Replace all files (signatures, photos, logos) with the backup versions
- You will lose any data created after the backup was made

Are you sure you want to continue?
profile.resetWarning:
⚠️ CRITICAL WARNING: This will PERMANENTLY delete all your data including:
- All stock cards and receipts
- All LBA units
- Your profile and settings
- All uploaded files (photos, signatures)

This action CANNOT be undone. Are you sure you want to proceed?
